{{Quote|You have proven youself adequate to my uses. I hereby name you my Dagger... and from now on you will be my personal assassin. I now need you to target your first victim.|Mother Gethzerion|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Dagger''' was an honorary title amongst the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The title of Dagger was bestowed upon a [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother's]] personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. Mother [[Gethzerion]],<ref name="SWG" /> founder of the Nightsisters,<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> was known to have chosen an [[Spacer/Legends|offworlder]] as her Dagger at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" />
